softly.line: Put your hands on my waist, do it softly
stanza: You got that medicine I need
Fame, liquor, love, give it to me slowly
Put your hands on my waist, do it softly
Me and God, we don't get along, so now I sing
Oh, hunter, if you didn't want
The beautiful so badly
Perhaps, you would've found it
In your spirit, singing softly
But hunter, you were human
Don't forget it and go safely
And I, I'll live without you
Though the struggle will be daily

softly.line: I promise to eat you softly
stanza: But I am the gentle cannibal
I promise to eat you softly
You won’t notice a thing

softly.line: Like I push my hands into pockets, and softly
softly.linePrev: I feel the cost of it pushing my body
softly.lineNext: I walk and I see it, this is all we deserve

softly.line: You've got to hold her and rub her softly
softly.linePrev: You've got to squeeze her, don't tease her, never leave
softly.lineNext: Try a little tenderness, ooh yeah yeah yeah

stanza: Talula, Talula, you don’t want to lose her
She must be worth losing if it is worth something
Talula, Talula, she’s brand new now to you
(Sugar, sweet love)
Wrapped in your papoose, your little Fig Newton
(Softly)
Hail soft storms of love on me
Let them play on my desires
Kiss me softly
Let your lightnin' light my fire
Your mouth sets free this captive
Come close to me
Free me
Untangle the madness that knots me
You drop to your knees, you crawl across me
You lick your lips softly
It’s firesmoke

softly.line: At the end of his tether, as usual, he breathes softly
softly.linePrev: He rolls over, cold pillow, warm body
softly.lineNext: He burrows down deep, and he closes his eyes
